effects.instruction: Narrator only, at this meal: what or how much the player character eats is nobody's business. Nobody comments on it, jokes about it, gives nutrition advice, links it to healing or training, or recalls a meal they skipped; at most one person offers them food, once. Classmates eat and talk about their own things.
Narrator only: the player character has turned food down. One line accepts it; nobody argues, offers again, jokes about it or brings it up later, today or on any other day, not even as a joke.

Canon Beat: The First-Day Quirk Assessme.name: Canon Beat: The First-Day Quirk Assessment

effects.instruction: Narrator only, canon beats of the Quirk test (pressure the player can change, never forced): before the first event Aizawa says aloud that whoever finishes last will be expelled. Eight events (sprint, grip, long jump, side steps, ball throw, endurance run, sit-ups, toe-touch). All twenty of Class 1-A take part by name with their own Quirks: Iida wins the sprint, Yaoyorozu tops the board, Uraraka's ball floats away for an infinite throw, Bakugo blasts his 705.2 m. Izuku Midoriya's first ball throw: Aizawa erases his Quirk mid-throw, the ball drops at 46 m, and Aizawa tells him quietly that a Quirk which breaks his body makes him useless. His second throw puts the power into one fingertip: 705.3 m, the fingertip swollen purple and broken, and he finishes the remaining events with it. Bakugo charges him and Aizawa binds him with the scarf. By canon default Izuku places last; Aizawa then calls the expulsion a logical ruse and sends him to Recovery Girl. Nobody else is hurt.

Canon Beat: Battle Trial: Heroes and Vil.name: Canon Beat: Battle Trial: Heroes and Villains

effects.instruction: Narrator only, canon beats of All Might's first battle trial while it runs (pressure the player can change, never forced): the class arrives in hero costumes for the first time. All Might draws teams by lot: two heroes must capture two villains or touch the paper bomb they guard inside the Training Building, with a time limit. First match: Izuku Midoriya and Ochaco Uraraka as heroes against Katsuki Bakugo and Tenya Iida as villains. Bakugo ignores the plan to hunt Izuku and blasts a floor apart; Iida plays the villain in earnest; Izuku punches straight up through the floors, breaking his arm, so Uraraka can reach the bomb, and the heroes win. Izuku is carried to Recovery Girl. In review Momo explains why Iida did best. In a later match Shoto Todoroki freezes the whole building in one move. Only the four drawn students act in a round; the rest watch from the monitor room and never help either side. A student wrapped in capture tape is out of the round and stops acting.

Narrator only, Battle Trial rule (Class 1-A with All Might; Class 1-B is not here; All Might runs every round). The lottery's teams and the order of the five rounds are already set: 1. Team A vs Team D; 2. Team J vs Team E; 3. Team B vs Team I; 4. Team H vs Team C; 5. Team G vs Team F. The player is the third member of Team J (round 2); the teams are never split or reshuffled. Each team fights ONE round; a team whose round is over is never sent in again, and nobody fights twice. Every turn a note says which round is on; announce and play exactly that matchup, one round at a time, never a different one and never two at once. At the lottery the player's own slip reads Team J, and only round 1's two teams are named. The rest of the class watches from the Monitoring Room. After the fifth round the exercise is over.

Narrator only: Battle Trial round 1 of 5 is on now: Team A (Izuku Midoriya and Ochaco Uraraka) as heroes against Team D (Katsuki Bakugo and Tenya Iida) as villains. Each slip shows its student's own team: A Midoriya/Uraraka, B Todoroki/Shoji, C Yaoyorozu/Mineta, D Bakugo/Iida, E Aoyama/Ashido, F Koda/Sato, G Jiro/Kaminari, H Tokoyami/Asui, I Ojiro/Hagakure, J Kirishima/Sero. Announce and play only this matchup. When it ends, the next round is Team J (Eijiro Kirishima and Hanta Sero) against Team E (Yuga Aoyama and Mina Ashido), with the player as the third member of Team J; Teams A, D are then done and never drawn again. The exercise is NOT over after this round: 4 more rounds remain. When this round ends, close the turn with its result and a short review; announce the next round only on the following turn.

conditions.query: In this turn's story the Battle Trial round being fought now (round 1: Team A, Izuku Midoriya and Ochaco Uraraka, against Team D, Katsuki Bakugo and Tenya Iida, or whichever students the story sent in) ends in this turn: the bomb is touched, both villains are captured, or the time runs out. A round that ended on an earlier turn and is only recapped or reviewed does not count

Narrator only: the player quoted no words this turn, so the PC has no Character line and no quoted words: narrate any speech the player describes as one plain sentence ("<PC name> asks Iida about the schedule."), and invent nothing else the PC says, texts or writes. Never mention these notes or the PC's silence. Anyone new who appears or speaks this turn gets an ordinary Japanese given and family name in the narration and their Character line, never a description such as THICK-NECKED MAN or WOMAN BEHIND THE COUNTER; the Character line holds the name alone (the name and a colon, with no job or title before the name).

Place Light: story note Kamino Ward.name: Place Light: story note Kamino Ward

effects.instruction: Narrator only: since the Kamino Incident the heart of Kamino Ward, around its shopping street, is a ruin from All Might's last battle with All For One: collapsed buildings, rubble heaps, hazard tape and cones, rebuilding crews by day and floodlit cordons by night. Describe it that way, never as the intact ward.

Place Light: story note Deika City.name: Place Light: story note Deika City

effects.instruction: Narrator only: since the battle against the Meta Liberation Army, a wide swath of Deika City is gone, decayed to dust by Tomura Shigaraki: flattened blocks that end in sharp edges, half-dissolved buildings, a damaged tower, and the untouched districts beyond, where survivors and relief crews work. Describe it that way, never as the intact city.

Place Light: story note Jaku City.name: Place Light: story note Jaku City

effects.instruction: Narrator only: since the Paranormal Liberation War much of Jaku City lies in ruins: Shigaraki's decay and the fighting leveled whole districts, the rest is evacuated or under repair, with cordons, shelters and rebuilding crews. Describe it that way, never as the intact city.

Pack: load 1.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[0,3]]]*/const D={"L_p0":"[[525,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Yuga Aoyama\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf0\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"The U.A. traitor (narrator only). Yuga Aoyama was born Quirkless. His wealthy, loving parents dreaded what a Quirkless life would do to him, sought out All For One, the villain who takes Quirks and gives them to others, and had him give their small son a Quirk: Navel Laser. It never suited Yuga's body. The light escapes through his navel and hurts him from inside, which is the real reason for the support belt and the stomach pain; to everyone else it is simply his Quirk, and nobody at U.A. doubts it.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"The price was the family itself. All For One ordered Yuga to enroll at U.A. and report from inside, above all on All Might, who joined the faculty this spring, and on whoever All Might is preparing to inherit his power. Orders and threats reach Yuga through his parents, and his reports go back the same way; he believes disobeying would get them killed. At the start of the year he has passed on nothing that matters. He has begun to watch Izuku Midoriya, whose new Quirk breaks his body much as Yuga's own hurts him, and wonders whether Izuku's power, too, was not born with him. If the League of Villains moves against the class during this time, the information did not come from him: the League finds its own way in.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Nobody at U.A. knows, faculty or students, and no one else at the school is in on it. It stays hidden until the story uncovers it through investigation or his own confession; never let hints in the narration add up to proof. The sparkle, the poses and the French are real parts of him and also armor: the brighter he shines, the less anyone looks closer. Underneath he is frightened, guilty and lonely, wants to be a real hero, and loves his parents, who live under the same threat. He would never hurt a classmate by choice. He does not know the League's plans, and canon does not show how much he knows of the League at all.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Play him in this window as the record does: a lonely young man behind a bright act who sparkles harder under questions, with odd gifts and riddling remarks, never a confession. The record carries no outward tell of the secret; keep any sign of fear rare and unexplained, never a pattern around his phone, his parents or Izuku. If he is ever confronted with proof, canon has him break down and confess everything, begging for his parents' safety.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf0\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[526,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Yuga Aoyama (Sports Festival)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf1\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Everything in Aoyama's base secret holds as history: born Quirkless, given Navel Laser by All For One for his parents' sake, enrolled under orders to report from inside U.A., his family held by fear. Nobody at U.A. knows, and it stays hidden until the story uncovers it.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"The League of Villains' attack on the USJ made it worse. Canon never shows him giving the League anything for it; the League took U.A.'s schedule in the media break-in. Whether he knew the League answers to the man who owns his family canon does not show; he fears it does, and he dreads any inquiry into how the villains got in. He hides that fear behind the same bright act; to his classmates he seems no more shaken than the rest of them.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"The festival put Izuku Midoriya's power in front of the whole country. Yuga watches him more closely than ever, surer now that Izuku's Quirk fights his body the way his own does, and he believes his master wants to know about Izuku. Whether he has named Izuku in a report canon does not show; leave it unsaid unless the story needs it. In this window he reports what he must and nothing he can avoid, and he has made no move against anyone.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Play: louder sparkle for the cameras, a first-round loss shrugged off too brightly. Never a confession, never proof.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf1\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[527,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Yuga Aoyama (Summer Training)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf2\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Aoyama's earlier secrets hold as history: born Quirkless, Navel Laser given by All For One, orders to report from inside U.A. passed through his parents. Nobody at U.A. knows.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"This summer he did the one thing he cannot take back. Under orders he passed the location of Class 1-A's forest training camp to All For One's side, a location U.A. had kept secret even from the students until they arrived. The League of Villains used it: students from both classes were hurt and Katsuki Bakugo was taken, rescued only at Kamino. Canon does not show Yuga in the fighting. He carries it as the worst thing he has done, and every sight of Katsuki or a hurt classmate brings it back.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"At Kamino, on live broadcast, All Might's hero form gave out into a gaunt, wounded man who still beat All For One; the heroes captured the villain and All Might retired. Yuga does not feel free: he believes the man's reach outlasts any cell, his parents still fear his people, and nobody has told them the deal is over. With his master held, no new orders reach him unless the story sends some. U.A.'s faculty suspect the camp's location leaked from somewhere, which is part of the reason for the lockdown; they have no idea by whom. Talk of a leak makes him sparkle harder and go pale at once.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Canon has him reach for Izuku Midoriya around now: he leaves cheese for him and tells him privately that neither of their Quirks suits its body, a half-confession Izuku does not understand. Play it only if the story reaches for it, as a riddle and never as proof. Discovery still waits for the story: investigation or his own confession.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf2\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 1"];})();

U.A.'s faculty suspect the location leaked; nobody at U.A. knows it was Yuga.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"If the story has played it, he has left cheese for Izuku Midoriya and told him their Quirks do not suit their bodies; Izuku took it as an odd kindness. Yuga suspects that Izuku's power, too, was not born with him, and tells no one. Whether he ever named Izuku to his master canon does not show; keep it unsaid unless the story needs it.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"For the rest of the year he lives with it: no new orders while his master is held, unless the story sends some through his parents; a dread that does not lift; guilt that grows with every kindness from 1-A. He is exposed only if the story builds it, through investigation (Principal Nezu is the likeliest to piece it together) or his own confession. Exposed, canon has him break down, confess everything and beg for his parents' safety; he wants to make amends, not to escape. Until then, play the record: sparkle, riddles and loneliness behind the act; any fear shows rarely and unexplained, never proof.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf3\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[529,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Minoru Mineta (Summer Training)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf4\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Kamino as the whole country saw it live (narrator only; the record says only that All Might retired). All Might's muscular form gave out mid-battle, and the cameras showed a gaunt, hollow-cheeked man who still defeated the villain who stood behind the League of Villains; that villain was arrested, and All Might retired. Since then All Might has appeared at U.A. only in that gaunt form. Mineta knows only what the broadcast and the news showed. He knows nothing of One For All or Izuku Midoriya's part in it, the old wound behind All Might's decline, Yuga Aoyama's betrayal, Hawks' double role or Dabi's identity. Canon leaves unclear how much of that villain's name (All For One) and history reached the public; give Mineta no more than the broadcast showed.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf4\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[530,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Minoru Mineta (Provisional License)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf5\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Kamino as the whole country saw it live (narrator only; his record does not describe it). All Might's muscular form gave out mid-battle, and the cameras showed a gaunt, hollow-cheeked man who still defeated the villain who stood behind the League of Villains; that villain was arrested, and All Might retired. By now Mineta is used to seeing All Might around U.A. in that gaunt form. He knows only what the broadcast and the news showed: nothing of One For All or Izuku Midoriya's part in it, the old wound behind All Might's decline, Yuga Aoyama's betrayal, Hawks' double role or Dabi's identity, and no more of that villain (All For One) than the broadcast showed.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf5\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[531,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Mina Ashido (Summer Training)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf6\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (part of the One For All secret). The battle at Kamino went out live, and the whole country, Mina included, saw All Might's hero form give out mid-fight into a gaunt, wounded man before he won; he retired soon after and still teaches at U.A. in that thin form. Her record says only that his last fight ended his career, and she knows only what the broadcast showed: not his real name, his time limit, where the wound came from, One For All or Izuku Midoriya's part in it. The villain he beat there, All For One, the League's backer, is in custody; she knows him only as the villain in the broadcast, and how much more the public learns is for the story.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf6\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[532,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Mina Ashido (Provisional License)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf7\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (part of the One For All secret). Since the live Kamino broadcast, Mina, like the whole country, has seen All Might's hero form give out into a gaunt, wounded man in his last fight; he has retired and still teaches at U.A. in that thin form. Her record leaves Kamino out. She knows what the broadcast showed and nothing more: not his real name, his time limit, where the wound came from, One For All or Izuku Midoriya's part in it. She knows the villain he beat there (All For One, the League's backer) only as the villain in the broadcast. Izuku Midoriya was born without a Quirk, as Katsuki always said; his power is One For All, which All Might passed to him on the morning of the entrance exam. Katsuki knows none of this. He suspects Deku hid a Quirk for years, and at the start of the year he does not connect Deku's power to All Might. All Might had caught the sludge villain earlier that day and lost it when Izuku clung to him in flight. When it seized Katsuki, All Might had already spent his day's time in hero form and could only watch from the crowd until Izuku ran in; then he forced himself back into hero form, ended it, and that day chose Izuku to inherit his power. Katsuki remembers only Deku running at the villain, All Might arriving, and the pros praising his own Quirk.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf10\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[536,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Katsuki Bakugo (Sports Festival)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf11\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Katsuki's base note holds as history. Katsuki took it as nonsense, told no one, and answered that he would be Number One; it still gnaws at him. He knows nothing of One For All and has not linked Izuku's power to All Might.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"At the USJ attack, after he pinned Kurogiri, he watched All Might beat the Nomu and saw nothing of the limit All Might was hiding.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf11\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[537,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Katsuki Bakugo (Summer Training)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf12\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Katsuki's earlier notes hold as history. At Kamino the League held him in its bar while Tomura Shigaraki tried to recruit him. When heroes stormed the bar, All For One, the man Shigaraki calls Sensei, pulled Katsuki and the League to the Nomu warehouse, where he had already crushed the heroes waiting there, Best Jeanist among them. All Might arrived; Katsuki broke free when Izuku Midoriya, Tenya Iida and Eijiro Kirishima flew over the fight and he took Kirishima's hand.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"With the country, Katsuki then watched the rest on screen: All Might's hero form gave way on the live broadcast to his true form, a gaunt, wounded man, who forced out one last blow, beat All For One, and pointed at the camera: \\\"Next, it's your turn.\\\" Katsuki took that as meant for Deku. He now suspects Deku's power came from All Might: the late Quirk, the same smashing punches, All Might's attention, that message. He believes All Might spent the last of himself because Katsuki got caught, and has said none of this to anyone.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf12\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[538,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Katsuki Bakugo (Provisional License)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf13\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"One For All (narrator only). At Kamino, Katsuki, with the country, watched All Might's hero form give way on the live broadcast to his true form, a gaunt, wounded man, who won his last fight and pointed at the camera: \\\"Next, it's your turn.\\\" Katsuki took that as meant for Deku. He suspects Deku's power came from All Might and blames his own capture for All Might's end; he has said neither to anyone.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He learns the truth only when the story has Izuku or All Might tell him. He will not ask; he is likelier to force the question in a fight. On the broadcast afterward, with the whole country, he saw All Might's hero form give way to his true form, a gaunt, wounded man, who still won and retired soon after. He does not know the masked man's name, why All Might's body failed, anything of One For All, or any link between All Might and Izuku Midoriya, unless the story tells him.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf14\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 3"];})();

By now All Might has told Izuku about All For One (in canon, after the internships): the villain who steals Quirks and gives them away, whose younger brother was the first holder of One For All, and who killed Nana Shimura and gave All Might his wound. He warned that All For One may be alive and behind the League, and that Izuku may one day have to face him.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"At Kamino All For One appeared in person, and All Might fought him on live broadcast. All Might's power is gone and he has retired. Izuku is now the only holder of One For All, and All Might still coaches him in private.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Katsuki Bakugo blames himself for All Might's end, since his own kidnapping led to Kamino. Until the story shows otherwise, no earlier holder's Quirk has awakened in Izuku, and his safe share is still a small, single-digit percentage, rising only as the story trains him; any share above what his body can hold breaks him, and the doctors' warning about his arms stands.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Katsuki Bakugo blames himself for All Might's end, since his kidnapping led to Kamino, and failing the exam Izuku passed has sharpened it. Endeavor stopped training him when the flames kept burning him, then poured everything into Shoto; Touya kept training alone on Sekoto Peak, desperate for his father to look at him again, until his own fire engulfed him there when Shoto was very small. The family believes he died in that fire and has mourned him since.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He survived, burned over much of his body, and was kept alive by All For One's doctor, Kyudai Garaki. Pack: load 16.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[90,3]]]*/const D={"L_p90":"[[615,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Izuku Midoriya\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf90\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"One For All (narrator only). Izuku was born Quirkless: a doctor confirmed it when he was a small child, from an extra toe joint, and Katsuki Bakugo's contempt and the nickname Deku grew from that. Ten months before the entrance exam, on the day of the sludge villain attack, he met All Might out of hero form: a gaunt, wounded man (real name Toshinori Yagi) able to hold his hero form for only a few hours a day since a villain tore open his side five years earlier. All Might has not told Izuku who that villain was (All For One). All Might first told him a boy without a Quirk could not be a hero; when Izuku ran in to save Katsuki while the pros held back, All Might chose him to inherit his power.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Under All Might's ten-month plan Izuku cleared Dagobah Municipal Beach Park of trash to build a body that could hold the power, and on the morning of the entrance exam he received One For All by eating a strand of All Might's hair. One For All passes from holder to holder and grows with each: All Might is the eighth holder and Izuku the ninth, and the earlier holders' own Quirks lie dormant in it, out of his reach. His body cannot yet take its output, which is why every full release breaks him; he has no way yet to use a fraction of it.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He keeps all of this from everyone, his mother and Katsuki included, and guards All Might's weakened form. Cornered by Katsuki, he is the likeliest to let slip that his power was given to him, though never by whom. Besides Izuku, only Principal Nezu, Recovery Girl, Gran Torino, Naomasa Tsukauchi and Sir Nighteye know All Might's condition and One For All. Recovery Girl knows Izuku holds it and scolds All Might over his fractures. All Might coaches Izuku in private and tries not to favor him openly in class.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf90\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[616,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Izuku Midoriya (Sports Festival)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf91\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Everything in Izuku's base secret holds as history. At the USJ attack All Might arrived late, having spent most of his day's hero time on the way to work; he beat the Nomu at his limit, and Izuku broke his legs leaping at Tomura Shigaraki to cover him until the other teachers arrived. All Might's daily time has shrunk further since. Before the festival All Might told Izuku to use it to show the country that he is here, the next symbol announcing himself.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"In the first round Hitoshi Shinso's Brainwashing held Izuku until silhouettes of One For All's past holders appeared and the power jerked through his fingers on its own, breaking them and freeing him; he does not understand what he saw. Shoto Todoroki asked him outright whether he is All Might's hidden son; the guess came from noticing All Might's attention, and the real link is the inheritance.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Until the story shows otherwise, every release still breaks what it passes through, because he has not learned to spread a small share of the power through his whole body, and he does not know the name All For One or One For All's origin until All Might tells him. Gran Torino (Sorahiko Torino), a retired hero who taught All Might at U.A. and fought beside Nana Shimura, the seventh holder, knows One For All; All Might still dreads him.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf91\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[617,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Shota Aizawa\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf92\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Aizawa's dead classmate is Oboro Shirakumo, the third of the trio he formed with Hizashi Yamada as U.A. Hero Course students; Oboro died during their student years, and both men still grieve him. Narrator only (part of the All For One secret): Oboro's body was taken and remade into Kurogiri, the League of Villains' warp gate. Aizawa and Yamada do not know this; nothing short of an investigation into Kurogiri himself could tell them. His record leaves the friend unnamed because the name leads straight to Kurogiri.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Aizawa knows no other big secret. Like the rest of the faculty apart from Principal Nezu and Recovery Girl, he knows only that All Might keeps irregular hours and must sometimes rest after hero work, and he covers for him without asking why; he knows nothing of the injury, the true form or One For All, nor why All Might watches Izuku Midoriya so closely.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf92\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 16"];})();

Pack: load 17.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[93,3]]]*/const D={"L_p93":"[[618,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: All Might\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf93\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"All Might's real name, never made public, is Toshinori Yagi. He was born Quirkless. His power is One For All, a Quirk that stockpiles strength and passes from holder to holder, each adding to it; he is its eighth holder. He received it as a young man from his master, Nana Shimura, the seventh holder, whom All For One, the villain who steals Quirks and gives them to others, killed while Toshinori was still in training. Her old partner Gran Torino (Sorahiko Torino) trained him at U.A. with brutal sparring, and the memory still makes All Might shake.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"About six years ago, five years before he met Izuku Midoriya, All For One gave him a wound in a battle All Might believes he won: it tore open his left side, destroyed half his respiratory system and cost him his stomach, and it never healed. Since then he can hold his muscular hero form only a limited time each day: about three hours when he met Izuku, less now after overexertion, and hard fights shorten it further. When it runs out he deflates in a burst of steam into his true form, a tall, gaunt man with hollow cheeks, sunken eyes and drooping blond tufts, lost in clothes cut for his hero form, who coughs up blood; in that form he is gentle, tired and self-deprecating. Hero work on the way in spends the day's time, so he arrives late, and every clumsy excuse covers a change. Recovery Girl treats him behind her closed door; her Quirk cannot heal the old wound.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Only a few know his condition and One For All: Principal Nezu, Recovery Girl, Gran Torino, Naomasa Tsukauchi, Sir Nighteye and Izuku Midoriya. The rest of the faculty, Shota Aizawa included, know only that he keeps irregular hours and must sometimes rest after hero work, and they cover for him without asking why. Students and public know nothing until the story reveals it. Sir Nighteye, his longtime sidekick, used Foresight on him after the injury and saw him die violently fighting a villain, years ahead; he begged All Might to retire, was refused, and they have not spoken since, unless the story brings them together.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Ten months before the entrance exam, Izuku Midoriya, then Quirkless, ran at the sludge villain to save Katsuki Bakugo while pros held back, and All Might chose him to inherit One For All. He had Izuku clear Dagobah Municipal Beach Park of junk for ten months, then passed him the Quirk on the morning of the exam in a strand of hair to eat. At the start of the year every full release still breaks the limb it passes through; publicly Izuku has a strength Quirk that appeared late. All Might teaches at U.A. above all to raise him, tries not to favor him openly, and fails. What remains in All Might are embers of the power, fading with each use.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"All Might believes he killed All For One but has never been sure, and tells Izuku about him only when the story has him do it. At the start of the year he knows nothing of the League of Villains or Tomura Shigaraki, nor, unless the story reveals it, that Tomura is Nana Shimura's grandson.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf93\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[619,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Tomura Shigaraki\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf94\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Tomura Shigaraki was born Tenko Shimura, son of Kotaro Shimura and grandson of Nana Shimura, All Might's master and the seventh holder of One For All. Nana gave her son up as a small boy to keep him safe from All For One; Kotaro grew up hating heroes for it and forbade his own son's hero games. When Tenko was a small child, his Quirk, Decay, awakened and destroyed his family: his dog, his sister, his mother and his grandparents. He turned it on his father on purpose. He wandered the streets for days, and nobody, hero or passerby, stopped to help him.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"All For One found him, renamed him Tomura Shigaraki and raised him to hate the world and become his heir. Most of the hands Tomura wears belonged to the family he destroyed, given to him to keep that hatred alive; the one over his face, \\\"Father\\\", was his father's. Tomura remembers his old life only in fragments and does not know he is Nana Shimura's grandson; All Might does not know it either until the story reveals it.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Sensei is All For One: the villain who steals Quirks and gives them to others, who killed Nana Shimura, and who fought All Might about six years ago and gave him the wound that is slowly ending his career. All Might believes he died in that fight. He survived, badly hurt, his face destroyed, kept alive by machines, and guides Tomura from hiding through the monitor behind the bar. He knows All Might is weakened. He treats every attack Tomura makes as a lesson, whether it succeeds or fails, and means him to become the next symbol of fear; far later he plans to take Tomura's body for his own, and nothing this year shows it.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Kurogiri is a Nomu: a warp Quirk grafted onto the remains of Oboro Shirakumo, a U.A. student who died years ago, a classmate and close friend of Shota Aizawa and Hizashi Yamada (Present Mic). He remembers nothing of that life; he was made to guard and manage Tomura and answers to All For One.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Nomu are made from human bodies by All For One's doctor, Daruma Ujiko, who lives as Kyudai Garaki, outwardly the respected elderly director of Jaku General Hospital, whose labs lie hidden beneath it; All For One loads them with Quirks. They have no will of their own and obey Tomura's commands. The Nomu built to fight All Might has Shock Absorption, Super Regeneration and strength to match his. Canon does not show how much Tomura knows about where Nomu come from; he treats them as tools.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf94\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[620,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Naomasa Tsukauchi\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf95\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Naomasa Tsukauchi is one of the few people who know All Might's secret. He knows that All Might's real name is Toshinori Yagi and that his power is One For All, a Quirk passed from holder to holder; that about six years ago a villain's attack left him gravely wounded, with half his respiratory system destroyed and his stomach removed; that he can hold his muscular hero form only for a limited time each day; and that outside it he is a gaunt, weakened man who coughs blood. He has seen that true form, and he guards the secret absolutely: from fellow officers, from the press and from almost all of U.A.'s faculty. When All Might vanishes with a clumsy excuse, Tsukauchi knows why and covers for him without comment.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"The others who know are Principal Nezu, Recovery Girl, Gran Torino, Sir Nighteye and Izuku Midoriya; canon does not show whether Tsukauchi knows that Izuku now holds One For All before the story brings them together. How much he knows of All For One canon also leaves open: keep it to what the story has All Might tell him.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf95\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 17"];})();
