Pack: load 63.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[665,1],[666,1],[667,1],[668,1],[669,1],[670,1],[671,1],[672,1],[673,1]]]*/const D={"L_p665":"[\"Unless the story has established otherwise, the raid on the Shie Hassaikai is national news for a few days: police and heroes broke a yakuza house that had been making and selling Trigger and keeping a small child shut away, and its leader, Kai Chisaki (Overhaul), was arrested with his Eight Bullets. Sir Nighteye was fatally wounded in the fight and, by canon default, died soon after; the hero world mourns him. Investigators keep what the house was building out of the news, but rumors spread among pros of bullets that can take a Quirk away for good, and agencies grow warier of yakuza houses and drug supply lines. The public hears only that a child was rescued, and nothing about who she is.\"]","L_p666":"[\"Unless the story has established otherwise, the heroes' raids on the Paranormal Liberation Front end in a victory nobody celebrates. Many of the Front's fighters were arrested, but Tomura Shigaraki and the League's leaders escaped with Gigantomachia, Jaku City was left in ruins, and during the battle mass breakouts from Tartarus and other prisons set many dangerous villains loose across Japan. Heroes fell or were maimed, Midnight and Crust among the dead by canon default, and many pros resign in the weeks after. Public trust in heroes collapses: people arm themselves, form neighborhood watches, protest outside agencies and crowd into shelters they believe are guarded. Students and pros alike are worn thin, and the news counts the missing every night.\"]","L_p667":"[\"Narrator only, true until the USJ attack: Tomura Shigaraki is planning his first big move, an attack on U.A. Academy to kill All Might while he is teaching. He wants U.A.'s class schedule and a way past the U.A. Barrier. Kurogiri is gathering dozens of hired villains through brokers, paid in cash and told nothing about the target until the day.\"]","L_p668":"[\"Narrator only, true until the USJ attack: the detectives' office has a thin, growing file nobody has time for: over the last month several small-time crooks with fighting Quirks have stopped turning up at their usual haunts, and two were seen flashing new cash before they dropped out of sight. Tsukauchi has asked patrol officers to listen for a name.\"]","L_p669":"[\"Narrator only, true until the USJ attack: behind the arcade, a broker who never gives his name has been buying drinks for small-time crooks with fighting Quirks and handing out cash for paid work against heroes. He says his client is the League of Villains. The crooks brag about the money in the alley bars.\"]","L_p670":"[\"Narrator only, between the Sports Festival and the Hosu incident: unless the story has established otherwise, the Hero Killer Stain struck down the pro hero Ingenium (Tensei Iida) in a Hosu alley during the Sports Festival and has not been caught. Local heroes double their night patrols and the police warn people off the back alleys after dark; the city waits to see if he strikes again.\"]","L_p671":"[\"Narrator only, after the Kamino incident: the bar was raided and its front wall torn open; it is now a sealed police crime scene with tape across the alley, and the League of Villains no longer uses it. Unless the story has established otherwise, nobody from the League is here.\"]","L_p672":"[\"Narrator only, after the Kamino incident: the warehouse was raided, its tanks smashed or seized, and the ground around it lies in ruins from the battle; police and investigators control the site.\"]","L_p673":"[\"Narrator only, after Kamino and until the League moves on: unless the story has established otherwise, the surviving League members hide in rooms Giran rents above a shuttered shop off Chinatown Streets. They keep their heads down, argue about what the League is now, and meet outsiders only through Giran.\"]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 63"];})();
